scope.summary: Repin oraclemcp to the immutable driver-cx 0.9.2 family and qualify the exact consumer graph at the existing adapter boundary.
out_of_scope: Implementing or qualifying Oracle's future Rust driver backend
Adding automatic cross-driver fallback or changing backend-selection policy
Transferring crates.io ownership without Oracle's verified crates.io username
Changing VPD/RLS or SODA capability policy

entry_points.name: OracleConnection driver-cx adapter
entry_points.trace: The corrected exact-SHA clean-worktree workspace suite exercised query, execute, LOB, cancellation, quarantine, reuse, wallet/TNS, CQN, and VPD/RLS paths; the driver seam lint confined main-driver calls to crates/oraclemcp-db/src/connection.rs.

entry_points.name: release dependency gate
entry_points.trace: The release surface and preflight contracts now require the exact published oraclemcp-driver-cx 0.9.2 family, and the consumer receipt records registry checksums and the resolved graph.

limitations: Registry publication was externally verified, but live Oracle behavior is not claimed by this close.
Oracle's future driver API and Tokio runtime behavior remain separate qualification work.
The Asupersync nightly feature-unification issue remains tracked separately.
